channel.title: Aydin Ayanzadeh: publications and news
channel.description: New papers and research updates from Aydin Ayanzadeh, UMBC.

item.title: Modular Deep Learning Mechanisms for Auditable Next-Day Wildfire Spread Prediction
item.description: arXiv 2026, 2026. Modular deep learning augmentations for next-day wildfire spread prediction: wind- and slope-conditioned attention, retrieval-augmented correction, and dual-stream gating.

item.title: Characterizing an On-Device Depth-Aware Multimodal Workload in Assistive Navigation for Blind and Low-Vision Users
item.description: IISWC 2026, 2026. An end-to-end characterization of an on-device, depth-aware multimodal workload for assistive indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users.

item.title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation of Blind and Low-Vision People
item.description: CVPR 2026 Workshop (GRAIL-V), 2026. An agentic framework that converts a single floor plan image into a structured, retrievable knowledge base for safe, accessible indoor navigation.

item.title: WildfireVLM: AI-Powered Analysis for Early Wildfire Detection Using Satellite Imagery
item.description: IGARSS 2026, 2026. A vision-language model for early wildfire detection and risk assessment from satellite imagery.

item.title: Floorplan2Guide: LLM-Guided Floorplan Parsing for BLV Indoor Navigation
item.description: IEEE BigData 2025, 2025. Floorplan2Guide transforms floorplans into spatial knowledge graphs and language-guided indoor navigation for blind and low-vision users.

item.title: PURSUhInT: In Search of Informative Hint Points Based on Layer Clustering for Knowledge Distillation
item.description: Expert Systems with Applications, 2023. A clustering-based hint selection method for knowledge distillation: teacher layers are clustered and the cluster centers become the hint points.

item.title: Automated analysis of phase-contrast optical microscopy time-lapse images: application to wound healing and cell motility assays of breast cancer
item.description: Book chapter, Academic Press, 2023. An end-to-end workflow for analyzing phase-contrast microscopy data from cell motility and wound healing assays.

item.title: Improved cell segmentation using deep learning in label-free optical microscopy images
item.description: Turkish Journal of Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences, 2021. A modified U-Net with a pretrained ResNet-18 encoder, residual decoder blocks, and a redesigned skip-connection for cell segmentation in label-free microscopy images.

item.title: Representation learning using graph autoencoders with residual connections
item.description: arXiv 2021, 2021. Residual connections for deep graph autoencoders: ResVGAE, a deep variational graph autoencoder with multiple residual modules, for link prediction.

item.title: Deep Learning based Segmentation Pipeline for Label-Free Phase-Contrast Microscopy Images
item.description: SIU 2020, 2020. A deep learning segmentation pipeline for label-free phase-contrast microscopy images, improving U-Net and FPN with an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-18 encoder.

item.title: Graph Embedding For Link Prediction Using Residual Variational Graph Autoencoders
item.description: SIU 2020, 2020. Residual Variational Graph Autoencoder (RVGAE): residual connections boost variational graph autoencoders for link prediction.

item.title: A New Class of Scaling Matrices for Scaled Trust Region Algorithms
item.description: arXiv 2019, 2019. A new class of affine scaling matrices for interior point Newton-type methods, defined as a convex combination of well-known scaling matrices.

item.title: Cell Segmentation of 2D Phase-Contrast Microscopy Images with Deep Learning Method
item.description: TIPTEKNO 2019, 2019. A multiresolution U-Net with multi-combination augmentation for cell segmentation in 2D phase-contrast microscopy images.

item.title: Automated Segmentation of Cells in Phase Contrast Optical Microscopy Time Series Images
item.description: TIPTEKNO 2019, 2019. Traditional image processing and deep learning approaches for automated cell segmentation from phase-contrast microscopy time series, evaluated against manually annotated datasets.

item.title: Modified Deep Neural Networks for Dog Breeds Identification
item.description: Preprints 2018, 2018. Fine-tuned pretrained ImageNet models for dog breed identification, reaching 89.66% test accuracy on the Stanford Dogs dataset.

item.title: A Modified Ant colony Based Approach to Digital Image Edge Detection
item.description: KBEI 2015, 2015. A modified ant colony optimization method for digital image edge detection, faster and more efficient than former ant colony based methods.

item.title: Gaussian Three-Dimensional kernel SVM for Edge Detection Applications
item.description: Conference 2015 · arXiv 2017, 2015. A support vector machine with a three-dimensional Gaussian radial basis function kernel for edge detection, outperforming Canny and Sobel detectors.
